4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 4 wherein said composition comprises a Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction from __Leishmania donovani__ and saponin, for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission in __dogs__.

5. (Currently Amended) Use of the composition of claim 4 for preparation of a blocking vaccine __in dogs__ to impede Leishmaniasis.

(Currently Amended) The composition of claim 4, wherein the Leishmania donovani promastigotes or amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates at 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine.
